why: Spec B §2.1 / B-02: kernel wins for all 294 MIRRORED-but-differing paths.
This file is what makes that direction safe. `doNotDelete` is the 43 paths the
kernel holds and the StuRa tree does not — a StuRa-tree-wins copy of any parent
directory removes them silently, because a copy cannot add a file the source
lacks. `kernelAhead` is the theme/OKLCH engine, where both trees carry the file
and the kernel is ahead; there the forbidden state is the kernel blob BECOMING
the StuRa blob. Neither arm pins the kernel’s own bytes: a port-back unit is
free to edit these files, it is only forbidden to delete them or to overwrite
amendment: Frozen is not immutable. A unit that DELIBERATELY deletes a protected path
amends this set in the SAME COMMIT as the deletion: remove the row, lower
`expectedEntries` by the number of rows removed, drop that row’s assertion from
check-do-not-overwrite.test.mjs, and re-run `make lint-port-back` so the vacuity
assertion is re-proved against the new count. An amendment that lands in a
different commit is a guard that lies for the length of a branch.
B10-resolver-fullhost is the first amender: DOMAIN_REGEX dies with the wildcard
edge, so B10 deletes gremion-ui/scripts/check-domain-regex.mjs and removes that
one row here (43 -> 42 doNotDelete, expectedEntries 45 -> 44) together with the
`has('gremion-ui/scripts/check-domain-regex.mjs')` assertion. Its guard-test
pair gremion-ui/tests/unit/check-domain-regex.test.ts is NOT in this set: it
classifies DIVERGED under diverged-bats-and-smoke (gremion-ui/tests/**) and so
never entered the measured 43. B10 re-measures rather than assuming a count.
No re-freeze unit exists or is needed — this file is a port-back guard, not a
tree inventory.
TASK-022 (the ACME edge) amends the set too: it deletes
docker/traefik/dynamic/tls.yml, the Cloudflare Origin default-certificate store,
on purpose (spec B Edge section 2, TRD-042), and removes that one row here
(43 -> 42 doNotDelete, expectedEntries 45 -> 44) together with its assertion,
which now asserts the path is absent from the set.
TASK-041 (L3-08) executes the B10 amendment above on the current count: it
deletes gremion-ui/scripts/check-domain-regex.mjs and removes that row here
(42 -> 41 doNotDelete, expectedEntries 44 -> 43); its assertion now asserts
the path is absent from the set.
